Messages.Author: jan willem
Messages.Body:
hello everyone, I was wondering whether it is possible for a vampire to
play, let's say bewitching oration, during a vote called by another vamp.
(which I also control), a sort of
'cloak the gathering at superior' effect. Thanks a lot.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No. Only the acting minion can play action modifiers (unless explicit
card text says otherwise).
